findings.source: Prophet: Скоро придёт персона с котом. Тебе важно впустить их домой.
findings.currentTarget: Prophet: Hivi karibuni atakuja mtu mwenye paka. Ni muhimu umkaribishe nyumbani.
findings.proposedFullTarget: Prophet: Hivi karibuni atakuja mtu mwenye paka. Ni muhimu uwakaribishe wote wawili nyumbani.
findings.objectiveReason: Source их admits both the person and the cat. Singular umkaribishe only admits the person. Preserve the explicit pair and reveal timing; this instruction leads to the cat-bearing character entrance.

findings.source: Firefighter: С приходом Гостей больницы потеряли свой смысл.
findings.currentTarget: Firefighter: Wageni walipokuja, hospitali zilipoteza maana yake.
findings.proposedFullTarget: Firefighter: Wageni walipokuja, hospitali zilipoteza maana yao.
findings.objectiveReason: Plural hospitali / zilipoteza requires plural possessor agreement yao. yake marks a singular possessor. No source fact, tense, speaker or causal order changes.
